pr_title: Docs: record Dispatcher patch fidelity incidents
pr_body:
## Summary

- add the ADR-audit recurrence to the existing unified-diff target-alignment incident
- record INC-003 for published patch bytes differing from the preflight artifact
- update the Dispatcher protocol so published patch blobs must be byte-identical to the artifact that passed strict preflight

## Validation

Documentation-only automation protocol and incident-log change; validate with the repository Windows Validation docs mode.
